denied.title: Only FOA's finance and staff teams can open this
denied.body: Refunds are for finance, staff admins, super admins and competition managers. Ask a super admin for a role if you need one.

meta.title: Refunds
meta.description: Refunds waiting for finance, with the gateway, and done.

list.title: Refunds
list.lead: A competition manager or staff admin asks for a refund; finance approves or rejects it. Cancellations and payments resolved in review are refunded without approval.

empty.waiting: No refund is waiting for finance.
empty.in_progress: No refund is on its way.

meta.title: Refund
meta.description: One refund: what it returns, who asked, and finance's decision.

detail.title: Refund of {amount}

notFound.title: We can't find that refund
notFound.body: The link may be wrong. Go back to the list to find it.

details.supersededByCancellation: The competition was cancelled. Its cancellation refund takes over this request.

detail.studentsNone: This refund returns a whole payment that confirmed no one, so it lists no students.
detail.policy: FOA's default: no refunds once a registration is confirmed, except when a competition is cancelled or someone paid twice. Approve a request only when FOA has agreed to an exception.

decision.lead: Approving sends the refund to the payment gateway, or to be paid back by hand for a payment made offline. You need to have entered your second factor in the last 10 minutes.

note.label: Note
note.hint: Up to {max} characters. Needed to reject: the requester reads it.

decision.ownRequest: You asked for this refund, so someone else in finance decides it.
decision.financeOnly: Only the finance team decides refunds.

errors.note_required: Write a note saying why it is rejected.

alerts.not_requested: This refund has already been decided. The page now shows its state.
alerts.not_rejectable: This refund can't be rejected now. The page now shows its state.
alerts.same_person: You asked for this refund, so someone else in finance decides it.
alerts.unexpected: Something went wrong on our side. Nothing was saved. Please try again in a few minutes.

failed.lead: Send it again, or close it if FOA paid the money back another way. Closing frees its students for another refund.
failed.cancellationRequired: The competition was cancelled. Send this refund again once the gateway can pay it.

alerts.not_failed: This refund is no longer failed. The page now shows its state.

manual.lead: The payment was made offline, so FOA pays it back by hand. Once it is paid, record how: the students are refunded and the payer is told.

reference.label: Reference
reference.hint: The transfer's UTR, the cheque number or the cash receipt number.

errors.reference_invalid: Enter the reference as it's written on the transfer, cheque or receipt.

alerts.not_approved: This refund isn't waiting to be paid back. The page now shows its state.
alerts.not_manual: This refund goes back through the gateway, not by hand.
alerts.same_person: Another member of finance must record a refund you requested.

done.approved: Approved. The refund is on its way.
done.rejected: Rejected. Its students can be asked for again.
done.recorded: Recorded. The students are refunded and the payer has been told.

meta.description: View a payment's refund history or ask finance to refund it.

request.title: Ask for a refund
request.lead: Choose the students whose fees go back, or every student left, and say why. Finance approves or rejects it.
request.notCaptured: Only a paid payment can be refunded. This one isn't paid.

dashboard.review: Discretionary refunds are available for payments received in INR. Finance can review this receipt in its original currency.
dashboard.required: Finance needs to refund this payment from the gateway dashboard.
dashboard.recorded: Finance recorded the refund from the gateway dashboard.

summary.offline: Offline, so it is paid back by hand

form.noneLeft: There is no amount available to refund for the students on this payment.

reason.label: Reason

errors.reason_required: Write a reason for the refund.

alerts.item_in_live_refund: A student you chose is in another refund already. The page now shows who is left.
alerts.item_already_refunded: A student you chose is refunded already. The page now shows who is left.
alerts.exceeds_paid: That's more than this payment has left to refund.
